integrity: The analytic proof and a self-contained standard-library checker are included. The checker verifies finite examples, but is not a proof of the universal theorem; no independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Requires n >= 3 and D >= 2, binary additive valuations, equal approved-degree D, and one or two positive approvers per good; wasteful transfers to nonapprovers permitted. It makes no Pareto-efficiency, strong EFX, larger-support or independence claims. The 2026 primary full text was not accessible; novelty is qualified.
title: Pseudoarboricity and the sharp welfare price of exact equity for two-sparse binary allocations
